text: SpotOn. Don't guess where to open. Ask the map.
Around Jakarta's stations, most businesses still pick a location on instinct. SpotOn counts what is really there.
Five hundred and sixty two walkable cells. Businesses from the MAPID catalogue, transit stops, premises on the market, and field records from MAPID Apps, counted cell by cell.
Ask Tapak, the AI guide, in plain language. The engine scores every cell for your business type, and the map recolours with the answer.
Open any area and see why. How busy it is, how many rivals, transit access, and the cost of space. Every figure comes from the data, never from the model.
Switch to 3D, or rank the actual premises on the market.
SpotOn, by team Triple T. Ask the map.
